_meta.purpose: The framework's state vocabulary (clone coverage states wave, Spec 48 FR-48-81): every mechanism SGS blocks and drafts use to express an interaction, disclosure, selection or page state, the state word it maps to, and how a reader reaches it. Seeded into the framework DB's `states` table by scripts/dbschema/seed_reference_data.py; nothing reads this file directly.

columns.state: the framework state word (block_attributes.css_state uses the same words): hover, focus, active, current, open, closing, disabled, hidden, scrolled, shrunk, visited, complete, dragging, playing, environment, or a form-field word
columns.family: pointer-keyboard, press, current, open, disabled, visibility, page, player, progress, form-field, environment
columns.kind: pseudo-class, aria, attribute, class, data-attribute, media
columns.token: the selector fragment as it is written; a class token is matched as a whole class or, when it starts with `--`, as a BEM modifier suffix
columns.reach: force-pseudo (CSS.forcePseudoState), set-attribute, toggle-class, call (the `call` method on the element), scroll (page scrolled past the header), emulate-media (Emulation.setEmulatedMedia), at-rest (matches without interaction), unreachable (the browser never exposes it)
columns.call: for reach=call, the element method that enters the state
columns.note: why the row maps as it does

_meta.forcePseudoState: Measured on the route's Chromium (145.0.7632.6, 2026-10-20) on a link, a checkbox and a details element, one custom property per candidate: forced = hover, active, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, target, target-current, checked, disabled, enabled, open, invalid, valid, user-invalid, user-valid, required, optional, placeholder-shown, indeterminate, autofill, read-write, in-range, out-of-range; never forced = visited (privacy), popover-open and modal (need showPopover() and showModal()), default, target-within, local-link, blank, the media states and the caption-cue states; at rest = link, any-link, read-only, empty (on an empty element).
